'''Note:''' Some pins were not used on the GK platform but were later added for others to control variable intake actuators. Those pins will be grayed out.

ECU Socket: TE 967288

C133-1 & C133-5: TE 1-968307-2 Plug / TE 927768-1 Pins / TE 1-965486-1 & 2-965486-1 Molex Inserts

C133-2: TE 1-968317-3 Plug / TE 5-963715-5 or 963715-6 Pins / TE 1-968322-1 & 2-968322-1 Molex Inserts

C133-3: TE 1-968325-3 Plug / TE 5-963715-5 or 963715-6 Pins / TE 1-968322-1 & 2-968322-1 Molex Inserts

C133-4: TE 1-968321-2 Plug / TE 5-963715-5 or 963715-6 Pins / TE 1-968326-1 & 2-968326-1 Molex Inserts
